Proof in the paper: The angles between the facets of a representative Pt3Mn CNC projected along the [0 0 1] direction indicated by the SAED (Fig. 1E) were determined to be approximately 9.5, 11.3, 14.0 and 15.9, which was in agreement with {6 1 0}, {5 1 0}, {4 1 0} and {7 2 0} crystal planes of Pt, respectively (Fig. S3), revealing that the Pt3Mn CNCs enclosed by HIFs were successfully prepared.
